notes: CR 608.2b with a multi-target spell (bug hunt 2026-11-12, KNOWLEDGE 197): seat 1 answers Shock with Sublime Epiphany, modes {counter target spell -> Shock, target player draws a card -> seat 1} (the word '8'), then with Cancel on Shock. Cancel resolves first and counters Shock. Sublime Epiphany still has a legal target (seat 1), so it resolves: its counter instruction has no legal target and does nothing, and seat 1 draws. The engine raised 'COUNTER_SPELL with no designated spell' here, voiding the game.
